text: AB-BA Secret Chat 是 DSH 的双人密码聊天插件，在左侧栏提供入口并把聊天页放入右侧栏标签；没有会话时可改用全局浮层。双方使用各自约定的两个密码配对后，可实时交换文字和图片，也能截取屏幕发送；客户端先加密内容，服务端转发密文，聊天房间随退出清理。适合希望在 DSH 会话之外进行临时私聊的两个人。插件不要求 API Key 或外部账号；聊天服务默认监听 8787 端口。

AB-BA Secret Chat adds two-person password chat to DSH. A sidebar entry opens a right-sidebar tab, with an overlay fallback when no session is open. Paired users exchange text and images; the client encrypts content before relay, and leaving clears the room. No API key or external account is needed.
想在 DSH 里和另一人临时私聊，结束后不保留会话。
如何在 DSH 侧栏打开双人密码配对聊天？
I need a temporary two-person chat beside my DSH session for text and images.
AB-BA Secret Chat 提供双人密码配对聊天：从 DSH 侧栏入口打开聊天页，输入双方约定的密码后即可等待对方加入并交换消息；退出时会清除房间。
dsh-abba-secret-chat 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · AB-BA Secret Chat · dsh-abba-secret-chat：A one-off, two-person password chat that docks in the **DeepSeek Harness** right sidebar. A and B each set a password and tell each other; **both must match** to pair. It is **end-to-end encrypted** — messages and images are encrypted in your browsers, so the server (and anyone sniffing the network) sees only ciphertext, and **only someone who knows both passwords can read them**. Nothing is stored or logged, and **everything disappears when DSH exits**.

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · AB-BA Secret Chat · dsh-abba-secret-chat：*A “Secret chat” entry appears at the bottom of the left sidebar; the chat opens in the right sidebar next to your main conversation, which keeps working untouched.*

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · What it solves：Sometimes you want to say a few private things to someone nearby (a colleague, family member, a friend) without creating accounts, leaving chat history behind, or mixing it into your AI session. Two people each know a password, one click opens a room that only exists while both are in it — and burns after use.

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · Features：- **Sidebar chat** — a **🔒 Secret chat** button at the bottom of the left sidebar (icon-only when narrow) opens a “Secret chat” tab in the **right sidebar**; the chat page is embedded in that tab. It can also be opened from the right sidebar’s “+” page. Your main conversation is unaffected.
- **End-to-end encryption** — both passwords stay in the browser and only drive key derivation (SHA-256 → PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 → AES-256-CBC with HMAC-SHA256 integrity). The server receives a pairing hash and ciphertext only: no passwords, no readable content. Packet capture on the same Wi-Fi sees ciphertext too.
- **Two-password pairing** — the A field takes A’s password and the B field takes B’s password; only when both are correct do two people meet. **Swapping the fields still works** (the pairing key is order-independent).
- **Two people per combination** — a third person using the same pair is rejected. If either side leaves, refreshes, or disconnects, the room is destroyed and both sides are cleared immediately.

**A. From the market (once listed)**

DSH → left sidebar **Plugins** → **Market** → search `dsh-abba-secret-chat` → Install.

**B. From a local directory (desktop)**

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · Install：DSH desktop → left sidebar **Plugins** → **Install** → **local directory** → point at this package → Install, then **fully quit and reopen DSH**.

**C. Command line (plain `dsh web` or a custom profile)**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-abba-secret-chat
```

Restart DSH after installing or updating so the new plugin loads.

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · Three-step usage：1. **Agree on passwords** — A and B each pick a password (4–128 chars) and tell each other **out of band**. Those two passwords are the only secret: they pair the room and unlock decryption.
2. **Both join** — A clicks **Secret chat** in the left sidebar, fills A’s password in the A field and B’s password in the B field, clicks **Start**, and waits. B opens the **peer link** shown in the panel toolbar (`http://192.168.x.x:8787`) in a browser on the same Wi-Fi and joins with the same two passwords (swapped is fine) — the two are paired automatically.
3. **Chat and end** — Enter or Send delivers in real time; **Image** picks/pastes/drops a picture, **Screenshot** captures the current screen. Either side clicking **End chat** (or closing/refreshing the page) destroys the room and clears both sides. A waiting initiator is cancelled after 10 minutes.
dsh-abba-secret-chat README · Three-step usage：> Want to try alone? Open `http://127.0.0.1:8787` in two browser tabs on this machine — one as A, one as B.

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|

  name: dsh-abba-secret-chat
  config:

dsh-abba-secret-chat README · Privacy and security：- **End-to-end encryption** — the two passwords only drive local derivation: `hA/hB = SHA256(password)`, sorted and hashed again into the pairing key sent to the server; the encryption key (`PBKDF2(hA|hB)`) and MAC key are derived separately and **never sent**. Messages use AES-256-CBC with a random IV plus HMAC-SHA256, verified before decryption. The server and network sniffers see only ciphertext and a pairing hash; reading content requires both passwords.
- **Memory only** — rooms, members, and ciphertext live in process memory; nothing is written to a database or file, and message content is never logged.
- **No browser storage** — the page uses no cookies, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, or IndexedDB.
- **Plain HTTP (content still encrypted)** — the page itself is served over plain HTTP on the LAN (default `0.0.0.0:8787`), but messages and images are application-layer encrypted, so captures show ciphertext. Use it on a trusted network; **anyone who knows both passwords can join**.
- **Isolated from your DSH session** — the chat page is a separate web page; its content never enters DSH session history or the model. The plugin
